summary.text: Perry Stambaugh is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 86, which he has represented since December 2020, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
His career experience includes work as senior director and editor of RE Magazine and owning and operating a farm.

paragraphs.text: Stambaugh graduated from West Perry High School and earned bachelor's degrees in broadcast journalism and history from Pennsylvania State University in 1982.
In the 2023-2024 session Stambaugh was assigned to the House Commerce Committee, where he served as secretary, and to the Environmental Resources & Energy and Labor & Industry committees.
